soundness_flags.label: Open-ended Question 1 / honest_scope classical-ID reduction
soundness_flags.one_line: The required W=∅ strict-positivity reduction to classical ID fails for fixed alphabets: a singleton-alphabet hidden parent can induce a latent-projection bow that classical ID treats as nonidentified although the fixed-alphabet model has no effective confounding and identifies by P(Y|X).
